css: body{font-family:'Archivo Black','Inter','Noto Sans TC','Noto Sans JP',sans-serif}.copy{text-align:center}.badge{display:inline-block;font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;font-weight:800;font-size:32px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--ink);opacity:.8;margin-bottom:24px}h1{font-weight:900;font-size:var(--title);line-height:1.06;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:var(--ink)}h1 em{font-style:normal;font-family:'Caveat',cursive;font-weight:700;font-size:1.45em;line-height:.8;display:inline-block;transform:rotate(-4deg);color:var(--ink)}p{font-family:'Inter','Noto Sans TC',sans-serif;font-size:44px;line-height:1.4;margin:28px auto 0;max-width:960px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}.el-features{font-family:'JetBrains Mono',monospace;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em;font-size:26px;font-weight:500;gap:40px 20px}.el-features>div{flex-direction:column;text-align:center;gap:18px}.el-features .ic{background:transparent;font-size:56px;width:80px;height:80px}
